description: This Java source file defines a final class NewEventForwarder extending Akka's AbstractActorWithTimers. It acts as an actor responsible for forwarding Thing events related to inactive shard regions. It manages subscriptions to event streams, reacts to cluster sharding statistics, and forwards relevant events to a shard region. The class includes methods for creating Props, handling various message types, updating subscriptions, and processing incoming Thing events.

classes.name: NewEventForwarder
classes.description: An Akka actor that forwards Thing events pertaining to inactive shard regions, manages cluster sharding state, and handles subscriptions.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation with specified dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling logic, including handling ThingEvent, cluster sharding stats, countdown timer ticks, and unknown messages.

methods.name: retrieveClusterShardingStats
methods.description: Requests current cluster sharding statistics from the shard region.

methods.name: updateSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the subscription state based on cluster sharding statistics, subscribing/unsubscribing for inactive shards.

methods.name: processThingEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming ThingEvent messages, enhancing logs and forwarding the event if relevant.

methods.name: getActiveShardIds
methods.description: Extracts the set of active shard IDs from cluster sharding statistics.
